name: Katy May Spencer
reason: Her own site (katymayspencer.com) now offers only personal and team leadership coaching with horses at a ranch in Ojai (a $1,500 team session and a $350 private session, with a tea ceremony as one optional part of a team offsite); it is a leadership coaching business rather than spiritual teaching, and with no videos, books, free practices or other offerings it is too thin for a page.
